Set up Google sign-in

Use the same Google Cloud project as your Android app. Add a new Web application OAuth client and enable the Drive API.

  1. Add the address below to Authorized JavaScript origins.
  2. Add your Google account as a test user if the app is in testing.
  3. Paste the web client ID here. The Android client ID will not work.

No client secret is needed. Your Google access token stays in memory and is never saved to browser storage.

Your Drive folders

Movies and episodes are recognised from their filenames, including S01E01 and season folders.

Local videos

Open videos from this device. Files stay on your device. Reselect them after reopening the app.

Playback

MP4 with H.264 video and AAC audio works best. Other formats depend on your browser. Dolby Digital Plus and AC-3 audio in MKV files is decoded inside IAMTT. Video still uses your browser’s codec support.

Profiles, folder selections and viewing progress are saved on this browser. They do not sync with the Android app.
